long_biography.plain_text:
Fikret Orman grew up around Orsan, the engineering business established by his father Abdülkadir in the early 1970s. The company developed from machine parts into braking equipment for commercial vehicles. Orman later took a leading role in the family enterprise and became its chairman, while also pursuing interests in construction and tourism.

He became widely known outside industry as president of Beşiktaş JK between 2012 and 2019. After leaving the football club, he remained active in manufacturing. Orsan expanded its international reach by bringing British hydraulic-equipment maker Edbro into the group, complementing its existing vehicle-braking products. His public sporting career and his industrial ownership are distinct parts of his record.
